metadata.description: A curated collection of Claude Code plugins that I use.

plugins.name: notifications
plugins.description: Notifications via desktop (notify-send) and tmux bell when Claude needs your attention

plugins.name: direnv
plugins.description: Reload environment variables with direnv on session start and directory changes

plugins.name: nix
plugins.description: NixOS and nixpkgs search via mcp-nixos — query packages, NixOS options, Home Manager options, nix-darwin, and more

plugins.name: agenix
plugins.description: Safe agenix secret management — read, write, and rekey age-encrypted NixOS secrets without foot-guns

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Plugin development toolkit with skills for creating agents, commands, hooks, MCP integrations, and comprehensive plugin structure guidance (forked from the official marketplace with skills marked disable-model-invocation, so they don't auto-trigger every session)
